title: Warsaw, 24 Dec 1627, to the Bishop of Olmütz? (DECODE R1408, ÖStA HHStA)

documents.shelfmark: ÖStA HHStA Staatskanzlei Interiora, Chiffrenschlüssel Kt. 14 Fasc. 20 f. 176 (DECODE R1408)

plaintext.source: DECODE lists it as non-decrypted; no reading found before this one.

transcription.notes: NOTES give 509 tokens as Tomokiyo splits them and 442 after joining letter pairs; the measured 465 counts the space-separated tokens of ct.txt as filed. Image not seen.

system.summary: Homophonic substitution with the alphabet in plain order on figures 13-33 (odd a-m, even n-z), letter pairs as consonant alternates, two-figure syllables, nulls a/m, and three-figure word codes.
system.notes: distinct_symbols is the measured count in the ciphertext. Ten word codes and {03} {04} {12} glossed from context only.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Figures 12-33 show a monoalphabetic Italian profile; a and m annealed as symbols fall to one vowel, so read as nulls.
5-gram annealing on the numbers alone, six seeds, with and without distinct-core constraint.
5-gram + dictionary coverage annealer converges on one key from random and seeded starts.
Same objective on three shuffled ciphertexts tops out far below the real order.
Converged key is in alphabetical order on odd and even figures, which the annealer could not know.
Letter pairs and rare syllable groups read from all occurrences; word codes glossed from context.

outcome.method_basis: An Italian 5-gram plus dictionary annealer converged on a key that turned out to be in plain alphabetical order on odd and even figures, confirmed against shuffled-ciphertext controls; letter pairs and syllables were then read from context in Tomokiyo's transcription.
outcome.notes: Every spelled word reads; ten word codes and three small groups glossed, not read. Sender and addressee inferred.
